```artifact
Feature: Prescription and Consultation Request Mapping

  Scenario: Generate a single prescription for a patient consultation request
  Given a valid patient consultation request
  When the system generates a prescription
  Then the prescription should be mapped to the patient consultation request

  Scenario Outline: Mapping prescription to consultation request
    Given a valid patient consultation request with <Consultation Request ID>
    And a valid chemist with <Chemist ID>
    And a valid lab with <Lab ID>
    When the system generates a prescription
    Then the prescription should be mapped to the patient consultation request
    And the prescription should be mapped to the chemist using <Chemist Pincode>
    And the prescription should be mapped to the lab using <Lab Pincode>

  Examples:
    | Consultation Request ID | Chemist ID | Lab ID |
    | CR001                  | C001       | L001   |
    | CR002                  | C002       | L002   |

  Scenario: Chemist receives a single prescription
  Given a valid prescription
  When the chemist receives the prescription
  Then the chemist should receive the prescription

  Scenario Outline: Chemist receives prescription
    Given a valid prescription with <Expected Prescription ID>
    When the chemist receives the prescription
    Then the chemist should receive the prescription

  Examples:
    | Expected Prescription ID |
    | P001                    |
    | P002                    |

  Scenario: Lab receives a single prescription
  Given a valid prescription
  When the lab receives the prescription
  Then the lab should receive the prescription

  Scenario Outline: Lab receives prescription
    Given a valid prescription with <Expected Prescription ID>
    When the lab receives the prescription
    Then the lab should receive the prescription

  Scenario: Verify only required fields in prescription
  Given a valid prescription
  When the system verifies the prescription
  Then only required fields should be present

  Scenario Outline: Verify required fields
    Given a valid prescription with <Expected Prescription ID>
    When the system verifies the prescription
    Then only required fields should be present

  Scenario: Assert specific prescription IDs match expected values
  Given a valid prescription with <Expected Prescription ID>
    When the system asserts the prescription ID
    Then the prescription ID should match the expected value

  Scenario Outline: Assert prescription IDs
    Given a valid prescription with <Expected Prescription ID>
    When the system asserts the prescription ID
    Then the prescription ID should match the expected value

  Scenario: Negative test cases for invalid Consultation Request IDs
  Given an invalid patient consultation request
  When the system generates a prescription
  Then the prescription should not be mapped to the invalid patient consultation request

  Scenario Outline: Negative test cases
    Given an invalid patient consultation request with <Consultation Request ID>
    And a valid chemist with <Chemist ID>
    And a valid lab with <Lab ID>
    When the system generates a prescription
    Then the prescription should not be mapped to the invalid patient consultation request
